name: account
title: Account
description: Show which Preyreach account or API key authenticated this MCP session.

name: get_search
title: Get Preyreach Search
description: Get a stored MCP search and its background enrichment progress. Keep calling with the same searchId while status is enriching. This read-only status check does not charge additional credits.

name: list_saved_leads
title: List Saved Leads
description: List saved leads for the connected Preyreach user. Requires OAuth.

name: save_leads
title: Save Leads
description: Save one or more lead objects to the connected Preyreach user's saved list. Requires OAuth.

name: search_leads
title: Search Preyreach Leads
description: Search live local-business leads and automatically start durable contact enrichment. Returns a searchId plus progress. If status is enriching, call get_search with that searchId until completed.

prompt.description: Example: find dentists in Austin with website and phone.
